'''Chorus fruit''' is a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Levitation}}. Eaten raw, it heals {{Hp|1}} and teleports the player randomly, as in vanilla (the tooltip calls this "Warping").<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/chorus_fruit.json}}</ref> Popped in an [[oven]], it gives a short burst of Levitation instead. The developer suggests stocking up on it in [[The End]].<ref>{{Cite video|quote=As soon as they get to the end, they'll make sure they stock up on chorus fruit.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Breaking ===
Chorus plants drop the pack's chorus fruit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/chorus_plant.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating chorus fruit heals {{Hp|1}} and teleports the player up to 8 blocks away, like vanilla chorus fruit.

Chorus fruit is cooked into [[Popped Chorus Fruit|popped chorus fruit]] (Levitation III, 0:03) in an oven only; kindling can't pop it. Popped chorus fruit makes [[Chorus Mochi|chorus mochi]], whose Levitation XXX for 1 second launches the player upward.
